name: Zed
description: A minimal code editor crafted for speed and collaboration with humans and AI.

overrides.post: desktop_shortcut --class "dev.zed.Zed" "$LINUXTOYS_TARBALL_DIR/bin/zed" && path_link "$LINUXTOYS_TARBALL_DIR/bin/zed" && { { is_steam || ! is_systemd; } || { askpass && sudo sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_instances=512; }; }
